 Wausau’s Grand Theater to reopen Nov. 7 after six-month renovation 
 Theater leaders say work focused on preserving 1927 character while upgrading audience experience 
 Grand Theater renovation nearing completion By Kailyn Martinsen Published : Nov. 1, 2026 at 3:45 PM CST | Updated : 2 hours ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google WAUSAU, Wis. (WSAW) - The Grand Theater in Wausau will reopen Nov. 7 with a performance by headliner Wayne Newton following a six-month renovation.
 Crews have worked the past few months to complete the project ahead of the reopening. Leaders of the theater said the goal was to preserve and restore the theater’s original 1927 character while upgrading the audience experience.
 What visitors will see
 Returning visitors will see custom handcrafted woodwork, hand-poured metal railings and enhanced acoustics.
 Olivia Hill, the theater’s associate director and general manager, said visitors entering through the front door will see a chandelier and a major donor wall with custom artistic design, along with handcrafted millwork and woodwork and hand-poured metal railings.
 “Those are the things that I want people to notice is the incredible intention that we’ve had for every step of this project and in the theater, the dedication to the historic character of it and really kind of us making sure that happened and that we really dedicated ourselves to maintaining the history of the theater,” Hill said.
 Community fundraising campaign
 Hill credited community support for the project. She said the Second Century campaign is one of the largest fundraising campaigns in Wausau’s history.
 “We had so much incredible support for the Second Century campaign ... it really showcases the incredible support that Wausau has come together to ensure that the historic theater remains in place and intact and healthy for the next 100 years,” Hill said.
 Final preparations
 Staff members are spending the next week finishing remaining tasks before the reopening. Hill said the theater is on schedule to reopen Nov. 7 with Newton’s show.
